Happy National Mom and Pop Business Owners Day!

The hard work and dedication of small business owners help keep South Carolina thriving. Today we celebrate their grit, perseverance, and American spirit!
On National Vietnam War Veterans Day, we honor the brave men and women who served our nation during the Vietnam War. Their courage, commitment, and sacrifice set an example for all Americans.

Happy Palm Sunday!

Blessed is the who comes in the name of the Lord! - Matthew 21:9

Big win by @GamecockWBB! Thrilled to see South Carolina grit and talent on full display as they dance into the Elite Eight! #MarchMadness


South Carolina Women's Basketball (@GamecockWBB)

THE GAMECOCKS ARE 𝙀𝙇𝙄𝙏𝙀 ✨

Sickle cell disease affects thousands of Americans.

With new gene therapies offering real hope, I’m urging the FDA to revisit a decision denying a Priority Review Voucher for a curative therapy. We need policies that encourage innovation and give patients access to life-saving treatments! scott.senate.gov/media-cente…

In Myrtle Beach, @RacersforPacers, is making the impossible possible. Devon Woodard was diagnosed with ALS in 2023 and he believed his time competing in 5Ks, 10Ks and half marathons had come to an end. Today Devon will be participating in the Cooper River Bridge Run and crossing the finish line in triumph.

“Now, my goal in life is to prove the doctors wrong.” - Devon Woodard #SCSweetTea wmbfnews.com/2026/03/23/nonp…

We’re here because Democrats refused to put the American people first.

It’s game day! Team Scott is cheering on @GamecockWBB as they dance through the Sweet 16! #MarchMadness

The Working Families Tax Cut permanently increases the Child Tax Credit to $2,200 per child, putting more money back in the pockets of hardworking families and supporting parents who are raising the next generation. This is about putting families first and delivering lasting relief where it matters most.

The left doesn't even care about protecting Americans who put on the uniform, go to work, and keep Democrats safe! America deserves better leadership.

Video

Great to see support for a commonsense solution! Wastewater monitoring helps us stay ahead of outbreaks, and the PREDICT Act helps keep Americans safe.


The Dallas Express News (@DallasExpress)

PREDICT ACT LAUNCHED TO MAKE WASTEWATER MONITORING A PERMANENT NATIONAL EARLY-WARNING SYSTEM

Bipartisan bill from Senators Tim Scott, Cory Booker, and others would restore funding and expand sewage surveillance to detect outbreaks like measles, RSV, flu, and potential bioterrorism threats before they s

After 41 days of the Democrats’ DHS shutdown, relief is on the way for hardworking Americans at the TSA, Coast Guard, FEMA, and cybersecurity operations.

Let’s be clear: it was @POTUS' strong leadership - not Democrats - that got DHS funding across the finish line.

Video

In South Carolina alone, @EximBankUS has supported 68 exporters and $9B in export value over the last decade.

That’s real jobs and real economic growth - not just numbers on a page.

Video

Led by @JJovanovicUSA, @EximBankUS is helping ensure America stays competitive with China and strengthens our small businesses at home.

We cannot afford to sit on the sidelines. The crucial work of the EXIM Bank gives U.S. companies the tools to compete and win globally.

Video

Every woman deserves real resources, real care, and real options. I’m proud to reintroduce the Supporting Pregnant and Parenting Women and Families Act to protect the community organizations that serve moms and families every day so no mother faces pregnancy or parenthood alone.

A handful of Democrats love voter ID—until it’s time to vote!

Video

Grateful for South Carolina’s grassroots leaders and our shared commitment to lowering costs and improving care for our veterans and families!


AFP South Carolina (@AFPSCarolina)

Great meeting with @SenatorTimScott on tackling affordability and improving health care access for our veterans. 

South Carolina’s grassroots community appreciates his leadership and focus on real solutions for a stronger, more affordable future!

Makes sense - right Whoopi?!


TV News Now (@TVNewsNow)

🚨 Whoopi Goldberg just got CALLED OUT by The View’s co-hosts after claiming she needs to show her driver's license to vote.

Goldberg: “You have to present your ID when you go to vote. I always have to give them my driver's license so they can make sure that it's me.”

Sunny Hostin: “You don't have to do that in New York.”

Sara Haines: “I didn't have to do it.”
